name: Perchloric acid
description: Perchloric acid (CAS 7601-90-3 ), commonly referenced by its formula HClO4, is a strong inorganic acid and powerful oxidizing agent used across analytical, industrial, and electrochemical processes. It is valued for its ability to dissolve resistant metal matrices and drive specific oxidation reactions under controlled conditions. In mining and metals processing, it is used for digesting refractory ores. This enables accurate elemental analysis in quality control workflows for complex alloy samples. Electronics manufacturers apply it in etching and surface preparation processes where precise metal removal is required. Surface activation is another key application in the electronics sector. Pharmaceutical and chemical laboratories use it as an ion-pairing reagent in HPLC methods and as a catalyst in organic synthesis. Water treatment operations employ it in pH adjustment and in the preparation of perchlorate-based reference standards. These standards are essential for the calibration of various analytical instrumentation. Perchloric acid is supplied as an aqueous solution, with 70% and 60% concentrations being the most commercially standard. Technical and reagent grades are available for diverse industrial needs. High-purity analytical grades meeting specifications for laboratory and pharmaceutical use are also provided. Packaging typically ranges from small laboratory quantities to bulk drums for large operations. Availability depends on the specific grade and regional regulatory requirements.
